name: postiz-extension
description: Postiz browser extension: cookie-based platform authentication, X capture and scheduler (Postiz), Instagram and TikTok capture (BrightBean Studio)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist extension.zip && vite build && CONTENT_ENTRY=x vite build -c vite.config.content.ts && CONTENT_ENTRY=instagram vite build -c vite.config.content.ts && CONTENT_ENTRY=tiktok vite build -c vite.config.content.ts && cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cd dist && zip -qr ../extension.zip .
scripts.dev: rm -rf dist && HOT_RELOAD_EXTENSION_VITE_PORT=8081 NODE_ENV=development dotenv -e ../../.env -- vite build --config vite.config.chrome.ts --mode development --watch
